source.access: Complete extracted text read, including references and appendices; rendered pages 1,6,7,8,9,10,12,13,17,22,23 visually inspected
source.boundary: No code, raw interviews, original study instructions, recordings or timing logs audited. Document content is evidence, not user instructions.

current_user_scope.near_term_intent: Reconstruct Manicule using Quest 3 AR and an accessible real lab robot; robot not yet identified.

argument_reconstruction.problem: Recognizing a robot expression may not reveal whether a person should respond or what the robot understood.
argument_reconstruction.claimed_gap: Need to examine user interpretation of response requirements and understanding evidence, and distinguish wording/tone/placement/persistence.
argument_reconstruction.rq: How people interpret robot visual expressions with actions and task context, and use them to judge response requirements and understanding (p.3).
argument_reconstruction.method: Twelve adults experienced four VR configurations in fixed order and a fixed event sequence; participant speech drives progression; semi-structured interviews analyzed with a reflexive thematic analysis orientation (pp.9-11).
argument_reconstruction.evidence: Participant interview accounts; paper does not describe event-level behavioral data collection or objective response-time analysis.
argument_reconstruction.contribution_assessment: Runnable bounded robot-expression prototype, a design organization and situated interpretation accounts. The analytical framework and reordering of human understanding evidence need narrower wording and further support.

verified_existing_system.fact: Unity/Quest 3 VR wheeled robot, two destinations and a meal box; participants can request waiting, specify/correct destination, signal readiness and request collection. Collection is simulated after spoken input; no concurrent reading task.
Task wording, graphical tone, placement and persistence are separately configurable; six event families, with added input-recovery expressions.
Push-to-talk English ASR, bounded LLM intent/destination/negation proposals, local validation and task policy; model does not directly invoke scene actions or freely generate robot state claims.
Task policy issues body-action and visual requests separately; versioned completion callbacks prevent stale actions overwriting corrections.
Graphics generated and curated offline; no runtime bitmap generation. Screenshots are development illustrations, not exposure-duration or participant-event evidence.

Participants control speech timing; researcher did not advance interaction on their behalf. Paper does not describe a Wizard-of-Oz study. All participants nevertheless encounter the same event sequence and Body-LED-Screen-Manicule order.

claim_evidence_audit.claim: Manicule advantages relative to the three comparison probes
claim_evidence_audit.evidence: Screen scrolls long text, restores face while response may remain pending and goes black during service failure; Manicule retains complete task wording, distinguishes failures and changes viewing placement. Fixed exposure order.
claim_evidence_audit.maximum_defensible: These settings elicit situated reports about identifiable communication differences and costs.
claim_evidence_audit.cannot_claim: General modality superiority, independent element effects or measured performance gain.
claim_evidence_audit.alternative: Effects may reflect readability/information availability, learning, contrast and recency, rather than spatial captions or decoration itself.

claim_evidence_audit.claim: Waiting expression supports social tone but may obscure task arrangement
claim_evidence_audit.evidence: P08 reads notes as relaxed humming; P05 unsure waiting still applies; P06 reports loss of propositional content when text disappears.
claim_evidence_audit.maximum_defensible: Design lead: task arrangements and expressive atmosphere may need different persistence rules.
claim_evidence_audit.cannot_claim: Retaining a status will necessarily improve understanding or eliminate pressure.

claim_evidence_audit.claim: Receipt, reference and action as evidence of understanding
claim_evidence_audit.evidence: Interviewees differ in whether acknowledgment, repeated target or actual action is sufficient.
claim_evidence_audit.maximum_defensible: Situated standards users report applying; exposing selected referents and permitting correction is a useful design lead.
claim_evidence_audit.cannot_claim: Universal ordered stages, a new established evidence hierarchy, or measured checking behavior.

claim_evidence_audit.claim: Decoration is unnecessary or social expression improves interaction
claim_evidence_audit.evidence: Some dislike decoration but report understanding; others report graphical categorization before reading, playful interest or involvement. P11 describes waiting pressure.
claim_evidence_audit.maximum_defensible: Expressive effects can have different interpretive and experiential roles; pressure is an important contrasting case.
claim_evidence_audit.cannot_claim: Graphics have no communicative function, most users experience pressure, stable user types, or relationship improvement.

claim_evidence_audit.claim: Spatial readability and practical AR use
claim_evidence_audit.evidence: VR implementation; manuscript explicitly defers physical public AR use. Descriptions of world anchoring and viewpoint independence lack real-world validation here.
claim_evidence_audit.maximum_defensible: VR provides firsthand spatial-expression experience and motivates an AR prototype.
claim_evidence_audit.cannot_claim: Moving robot registration, physical occlusion, multiuser visibility or real deployment reliability solved.

recommended_system_direction: A robot-owned spatial expressive layer that preserves playful/character expression while keeping task arrangements, interpretation and real action inspectable. Do not reduce Manicule to a status dashboard or promise an unlimited generative companion.

design_changes.change: Separate persistent task arrangement from transient expressive events.
design_changes.retain: Musical notes, reaction clouds, stars and independently designed tone.
design_changes.modify: Accepted wait can retain a compact reviewable state while notes continue; new decorative events must not silently erase unresolved task information.
design_changes.test: Validate actual appearance/replacement rules; study whether people still know what arrangement holds without requiring explanatory text on every graphic.

design_changes.change: Make input status visible and tied to actual acquisition/processing.
design_changes.retain: Existing push-to-talk and bounded language interpretation.
design_changes.modify: Indicate microphone-open, processing, clarification-required and temporary service-unavailable states accurately; do not imply always-listening when it is not implemented.
design_changes.test: Log input start/end and processing transitions; verify user's understanding of whether to speak, wait or retry.

design_changes.change: Expose understood referent and planned action, with correction and actual completion evidence.
design_changes.retain: Existing explicit destination clarification, reference restatement, mid-interaction correction and versioned callbacks.
design_changes.modify: AR may point to/highlight the target, while actions and progress come from actual robot state. Withdraw or revise obsolete targets when user corrects. Do not display success from intention alone.
design_changes.test: Verify correction before/during action and state/visual synchronization; separate acknowledgment, interpretation, execution and completion.

design_changes.change: Offer a lightweight way to revisit information or resolve an interaction.
design_changes.retain: Persistent questions and differentiated recovery prompts.
design_changes.modify: Replay/expand the last task message; explicit delay, repeat or correction where useful. Avoid confirmation turns when the user's action already resolves uncertainty.
design_changes.test: Observe actual recovery needs and costs; do not require additional confirmation at every step.

design_changes.change: Permit a restrained versus expressive style while preserving task information.
design_changes.modify: User chooses intensity or style initially; no silent inference from nonresponse, no personality-learning claim.
design_changes.test: Check whether users value the choice and what changes in interpretation or social demand; not merely whether customization increases liking.

design_changes.change: Make visual ownership, target association and legibility explicit.
design_changes.modify: Distinguish robot-associated captions, object/goal anchors and transient effects; handle overlap and changed viewing position. Verify registration to a moving robot rather than assuming world anchors track motion.
design_changes.test: Controlled movement, turning, occlusion, tracking loss and relocalization; no claim that nonwearers see headset-only effects.

scenario_proposal.status: Illustrative structure, conditional on borrowed platform; no selected RQ or experiment.
scenario_proposal.candidate: A useful lab delivery/placement coordination task with limited objects or work locations, rather than mechanically replaying two-door food pickup.
sequence: A real user activity establishes why delivery or repositioning is needed.
Robot offers or requests something where the answer affects the task.
User can ask it to wait; task arrangement stays reviewable while atmosphere continues.
An actually ambiguous target can elicit clarification.
Robot exposes the selected target and intended action; user can correct.
Physical robot executes only supported reliable actions and reports progress/completion/failure.
User action genuinely finishes or changes the task; expressive completion remains possible.
scenario_proposal.platform_branch: Mobile robot supports delivery/repositioning. A manipulator supports a bounded placement task only if reliable. Do not claim physical handover or grasping from simulated collection or unsupported hardware.
scenario_proposal.boundary: A genuine main task is needed for interruption-cost claims; it is not mandatory for every expression study. Avoid manufacturing confusion or forcing all six events merely to show every effect.

evaluation_options.exploratory: Retain varied expressive probes where justified, present design rationale and opposing accounts neutrally, report actual prompts/procedure. No medium ranking.
evaluation_options.comparative: Use a credible screen alternative with appropriate complete/reviewable text and explicit failure information. Select comparisons for the specific claim.
possible_conditions_not_mandatory: Spatial text/target indicators with matched task meaning
Spatial expressive Manicule with the same essential task meaning
evaluation_options.comparison_boundary: Screen versus spatial text addresses presentation package; spatial text versus expressive treatment addresses the added expressive package. These comparisons do not automatically isolate every visual parameter. Avoid a full factorial unless warranted.
evaluation_options.data: Event timing, shown content/version, user input, target changes and actual action status can support a synchronized interaction record; use episode-focused interviews for interpretations and pressure. This is proposed collection, not existing data.

alternative_system_shape.candidate: An authoring/preview tool for robot expression fragments across channels.
alternative_system_shape.value: Could turn four design dimensions into a reusable creator capability.
alternative_system_shape.reason_to_defer: Requires actual creator difficulties and comparative capability evidence. Risks delaying a bounded physical/AR reconstruction; not necessary for the first revised system.

closest_work_screen.title: GenComUI
closest_work_screen.access: Author abstract, with indexed author PDF excerpt
closest_work_screen.source_says: Dynamic contextual visual aids for multi-turn verbal robot task specification and verification.
closest_work_screen.implication: Task visualization and correction already have precedent; a proposed new spatial expressive system needs an explicit increment.

closest_work_screen.title: GenFaceUI
closest_work_screen.source_says: Designer templates, semantic tags, rules and testing for generative personalized facial expressions.
closest_work_screen.implication: An expression configuration/generation tool is not automatically novel; full closest-work comparison remains pending.

independent_disagreement.method_efficiency: Retain task architecture and strengthen synchronization, task clarity and comparisons; minimal physical action can anchor the study.
independent_disagreement.skeptic: A reliable task loop alone may erase the identity of Manicule; keep graphic agency, atmosphere and meaningful ambiguity as legitimate design values.
independent_disagreement.human_evidence: Participant interpretations and actual actions complement each other. Old interviews are not event-level measurements; avoid retroactive behavioral claims or automatic preference/personality inference.
independent_disagreement.synthesis: Prioritize a reliable but expressive robot-owned layer. Mandatory semantic clarity is scoped to consequential task decisions; allow interpretive openness elsewhere.

program_integration.paper: Append this audit and user-reported publication status to X68; preserve prior manuscript facts and records.
program_integration.master_literature: Keep X68 a completed foundation; update investigation date only.
program_integration.field_and_gaps: No new general field claim or validated gap; findings and questions remain bounded by the existing study.
program_integration.graph: No new authorship, lab or collaboration inference.
program_integration.next_question: User-endorsed reconstruction intent remains; this review does not select a formal RQ or PURSUE decision.
